notes: Marco's quoted request for the logo files is answered by Elena's commitment; it is the same loop, so the golden item is the commitment (a model may cite both quotes as evidence). Not golden: the palette PDF (done), business cards (deferred), 'What do we still owe you?' (answered), the disclaimer's 'delete it'. 'last Thursday' must never become a due date.
